[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Terraform Cloud/Enterprise"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Integrating Terraform Cloud or Terraform Enterprise into your Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines allows organizations to standardize infrastructure provisioning while leveraging existing code repositories and automation servers like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Architecture"},{"order":4,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Terraform Cloud or Terraform Enterprise account with an organization and workspace configured."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A Version Control System (VCS) or CI/CD platform (e.g., GitHub, GitLab)."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"A generated User or Team API Token from Terraform Cloud for authentication."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Configure the Terraform Backend"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"To connect your local or pipeline-driven Terraform configuration to Terraform Cloud, define the remote backend in your main.tf file."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"terraform {
  cloud {
    organization = "your-org-name"

    workspaces {
      name = "production-workspace"
    }
  }
}"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Set Up Environment Variables in CI/CD"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Your CI/CD pipeline needs authentication to communicate with Terraform Cloud. Store your Terraform API token as a secure secret in your CI/CD platform (for example, named TFE_TOKEN in GitHub Actions secrets)."},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Create the CI/CD Pipeline Configuration"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Below is an example of a GitHub Actions workflow that initializes, validates, and applies Terraform configurations using the remote execution mode or API-driven run workflow."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"name: "Terraform CI/CD"

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  terraform:
    name: "Terraform Run"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
        with:
          cli_config_credentials_token: ${{ secrets.TFE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init

      - name: Terraform Validate
        run: terraform validate

      - name: Terraform Plan
        run: terraform plan

      - name: Terraform Apply
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve"},{"order":15,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Enterprise Environments"},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use API-Driven Workflows: Let Terraform Cloud handle the heavy lifting of execution while your CI/CD platform triggers the runs."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Implement Policy as Code: Leverage Sentinel or OPA (Open Policy Agent) within Terraform Enterprise to enforce compliance before the apply phase."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Secure Secrets Management: Never hardcode credentials; always inject sensitive variables securely using workspace variables or secret stores."}]
